# Northwind Coffee Co.

Source: https://web.demo.busymate.ai/

> A specialty coffee roaster in Portland, Oregon, roasting in 5kg batches to order since 2016. This is a Busymate AI demonstration store — a working storefront you can shop, sign in to and put an assistant through its paces on. No order is fulfilled, no payment is taken, and the customer behind the sign-in button is not a real person.

## The coffee

| SKU | Coffee | Origin | Roast | Process | Tasting notes | Size | Price |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| NW-ETH-250 | Ethiopia Yirgacheffe | Kochere, Yirgacheffe | Light | Washed | Bergamot, jasmine, lemon acidity | 250g | $18 |
| NW-COL-250 | Colombia Huila | Pitalito, Huila | Medium | Washed | Caramel, red apple, balanced | 250g | $16 |
| NW-SUM-250 | Sumatra Mandheling | Lintong, North Sumatra | Dark | Wet-hulled | Cedar, earth, syrupy body | 250g | $17 |
| NW-ESP-250 | Northwind Espresso | Brazil + Colombia | Medium-dark | Blend | Chocolate, smooth, low acidity | 250g | $15 |
| NW-DEC-250 | Midnight Decaf | Huila, Colombia | Medium | Sugarcane EA decaf | Cocoa, dried plum | 250g | $17 |
| NW-SMP-4X100 | Roaster's Sampler | Four origins | Mixed | Varies | This week's roast, four ways | 4 x 100g | $26 |

Live prices and stock also come from the MCP server's `search_coffee` and `get_coffee` tools, and from `GET /api/store/products`.

## The roastery

Northwind started in 2016 with a 5kg drum roaster in a Portland garage and a standing order from the cafe across the street. We buy from the same six farms and cooperatives, roast in small batches to order, and ship the day we roast. Every bag carries its roast date. If one reaches you more than three days after that date, something has gone wrong and we want to hear about it.

## Policies

- [Delivery](https://web.demo.busymate.ai/shipping.md) — 2-4 business days for $5, free over $40; next-day $12 before 11:00. US and Canada.
- [Returns and refunds](https://web.demo.busymate.ai/returns.md) — unopened within 30 days; opened within 14 days of delivery, keep the coffee.
- [Coffee subscription](https://web.demo.busymate.ai/subscription.md) — 15% off, free delivery, every 2, 4 or 6 weeks, cancel any time.
- [Brew guide](https://web.demo.busymate.ai/brewing.md) — 1:16, 195-205°F, 3-4 minutes for a pour-over.

## The demo customer

One throwaway customer is provided so the identified experience can be tested without an account. Ask the assistant about an order or a return and, the moment it cannot yet see who is asking, a sign-in card appears in the conversation on its own; using it hands the assistant a short-lived proof of who they are, and order lookups and returns then work, for that customer only.

The customer is Alex Rivera, a customer since March 2025, with three orders — NW-10432 (in transit), NW-10218 and NW-09977 (both delivered) — and an active subscription of two bags of Northwind Espresso every four weeks.

## What an agent can do here

- Read: this page, the four policy pages, and each of their `.md` twins.
- Discover: [/llms.txt](https://web.demo.busymate.ai/llms.txt), [/agents.json](https://web.demo.busymate.ai/agents.json), [/webmcp-catalog.json](https://web.demo.busymate.ai/webmcp-catalog.json).
- Act in the page: five WebMCP tools — search the range, add to the cart, read the cart, check an order, start a return.
- Act over the network: the MCP server at `https://web.demo.busymate.ai/mcp` carries the catalogue and the policies, open to anyone.

---

# Delivery

Source: https://web.demo.busymate.ai/shipping

> What Northwind Coffee charges for delivery, how long it takes, and where we ship.
We roast to order, so a bag leaves the roastery within one business day of the order — never off a shelf.

## What it costs

| Service | Time | Price |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | 2-4 business days | $5, free over $40 |
| Express | Next business day | $12, ordered before 11:00 |

Subscriptions always ship free, whatever the order is worth.

## Where we ship

The United States and Canada. Canadian orders clear customs as roasted coffee with no duty under CUSMA; allow one extra day at the border during December.

## Tracking

Every order gets a tracking number by email the moment it is handed to the carrier. Signed-in customers can also just ask the assistant "where is my order" and it will read the current status, the carrier and the expected date straight from the order book.

## If it goes missing

If tracking has not moved for three business days, tell us and we re-roast and re-send the order the same day — there is nothing to prove and nothing to fill in.

---

# Returns and refunds

Source: https://web.demo.busymate.ai/returns

> How to send coffee back to Northwind, the two windows that apply, and what happens to your money.
Coffee is not a normal returnable product: once a bag is open, we cannot resell it. So there are two rules rather than one.

## Unopened, within 30 days

Send it back and the full price is refunded to the original payment method within 3-5 business days of it arriving with us.

## Opened, within 14 days of delivery

Tell us within 14 days of delivery and we will replace it with something that suits you better, or refund it. **Keep the coffee** — we do not want an opened bag back, and shipping it would cost more than the bag.

## Damaged or wrong

A split bag, a leaking valve or the wrong beans is our mistake. We send the right thing immediately and you do not need to return anything.

## Starting one

Ask the assistant to start a return for an order and it will confirm the item and the amount with you first, then open it. You can also reply to the order confirmation email.

## What is not covered

Coffee bought more than 30 days ago, and subscription shipments that were already delivered before a pause took effect — pause before the next roast date and that one never ships.

---

# Coffee subscription

Source: https://web.demo.busymate.ai/subscription

> How the Northwind subscription works — cadence, discount, and how to pause, swap or cancel.
Pick the beans and how often you want them. We roast on the schedule and you stop thinking about it.

## The deal

- **15% off** every bag, for as long as the subscription runs.
- **Free delivery**, on every shipment, with no minimum.
- A cadence of **2, 4 or 6 weeks**.
- First shipment goes out on the next roast day after you subscribe.

## Changing it

Anything can change before the next roast date: pause a shipment, skip one, swap to a different coffee, change the grind, or move the cadence. Changes after the roast date apply to the shipment after that.

## Cancelling

Cancel any time, from the account page or by asking. There is no minimum term, no notice period, and no fee. A cancellation takes effect immediately unless that week's coffee is already roasted.

## Gifting

A subscription can be sent to a different address with a note. It renews to the giver's card until they cancel it.

---

# Brew guide

Source: https://web.demo.busymate.ai/brewing

> Northwind's ratios, temperatures and timings for pour-over, French press, espresso and Aeropress.
Four numbers do most of the work. Everything else is preference.

## The numbers

- **Ratio 1:16** — about 15g of coffee to 250g of water for a balanced cup. Stronger is 1:15, lighter is 1:17.
- **Temperature 195-205°F (90-96°C)** — just off the boil. Hotter scorches, cooler under-extracts and tastes sour.
- **Grind** — coarse for French press, medium for pour-over, fine for espresso.
- **Freshness** — rest beans 3-5 days after the roast date, then use them within four weeks.

## Pour-over

Bloom with twice the coffee's weight in water for 30-45 seconds, then pour in slow circles. Total 3-4 minutes.

## French press

Coarse grind, four minutes steeped, press slowly and decant straight away so it does not keep extracting.

## Espresso

18g in, about 36g out, in 25-30 seconds. If it runs fast, grind finer; if it chokes, grind coarser. Our Northwind Espresso is blended for exactly this.

## Aeropress

15g, medium grind, 200g of water, stir once, steep 90 seconds, press for 30. Forgiving and hard to ruin.
